pairs.note: Pass 1 render (17:35, sha1 76844e1a8285) against the owner's frame of T1 @1.7 s. Every film rectangle avoids the three player icons (x 0.23-0.78, y 0.38-0.61) and the darkest vignetted corners. The horn is left out: in this frame it sits under the pause icon, and its colour is an open owner decision.

regions.label: forest on the slopes
regions.note: The film's forest here is shade with the teal grade (mean RGB 29,70,82); most of its saturation is grade.

regions.label: broadleaf clumps, right
regions.note: The film's only sunlit foliage free of the teal grade in this frame.

regions.label: the heart: beds and plinths
regions.note: Beds, copper plates and tributes are signals; this box keeps them out of the vivid-pixel check.
